name: @veridrop/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Veridrop (common + domain APIs)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle services --output src/.bundled/services.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle services --output src/.bundled/services.json && redocly bundle curation --output src/.bundled/curation.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle curation --output src/.bundled/curation.json && redocly bundle agreements --output src/.bundled/agreements.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle agreements --output src/.bundled/agreements.json && redocly bundle proofs --output src/.bundled/proofs.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle proofs --output src/.bundled/proofs.json && redocly bundle rewards --output src/.bundled/rewards.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle rewards --output src/.bundled/rewards.json && redocly bundle arbitration --output src/.bundled/arbitration.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle arbitration --output src/.bundled/arbitration.json && redocly bundle participants --output src/.bundled/participants.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle participants --output src/.bundled/participants.json && redocly bundle provenance --output src/.bundled/provenance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle provenance --output src/.bundled/provenance.json && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.json
